a more pronounced symmetry breaking effect at grain boundaries is a key factor for the magnetocrystalliine anisotopy reduction in CoPt : oxide granular films.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the magnetic properties of Co80Pt20 can be tailored by the presence of a thin oxide layer at the CoPt–oxide interface, which may provide a new approach to the design of magnetic thin films with enhanced performance.
the magnetic properties of CoPt : oxide nanogranular films can be tailored to meet the requirements for high density perpendicular magnetic recording media by adjusting the oxide content.
